_comment: Reference template for .claude/settings.local.json after /onboard v2.10.2 in --local-only mode (default). Markers (_onboard_managed: true on every hook block, _onboard_managed_env_keys in env) drive /onboard --uninstall surgical removal — standard JSON parsers ignore unknown fields. v2.10.2 added ONBOARD_LOG_DIR pointing at .claude/local-only/onboarding-logs so post-edit-check.sh / stop-verify.sh write their runtime logs INSIDE the local-only sandbox instead of leaking to .claude/onboarding-logs (which is the share-mode path and would dirty the PROJECT working tree). This file is Claude Code's per-user override, conventionally NOT committed. Hook paths reference the user-global skill install (~/.claude/skills/onboard/) so the project tree stays untouched. If you installed onboard as a project-shared skill, replace ~/.claude with ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude in the four hook command paths.
